{{Top|leg}}
'''Plague Group''' was the name given to the members of [[Wraith Squadron]] responsible for stealing and releasing a sample of [[Bunkurd Sewer Disorder]] during the [[Mission to Storinal]].

For the theft of the disease, the group consisted of Doctor [[Ton Phanan]], [[Kell Tainer]], [[Tyria Sarkin Tainer|Tyria Sarkin]] and [[Eurrsk Thri'ag]]. [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] joined the group to help release the disease aboard the ''[[Hawkbat's Perch]]'' and ''[[Hawkbat's Vigil]]''.
